source.label: n8n Labs blog, 10 Nov 2026, Meet Nod

thu_options_not_offered.copy: n8n Labs released Nod on 10 November, a free, open-source agent for Mac and Windows that works in your apps and on websites until a job is done. Six cards on three chores to hand it this week, and the one setting to switch on first: a monthly spending limit.
thu_options_not_offered.hook: A free AI that sits through the cancel screens for you.

pitch.see: Six cards. Cover: the house robot calmly saying no to a tower of pop-ups that beg it to stay. Then three chores Nod's makers list: cancel a subscription and turn down every offer to stay, watch a price and tell you when it drops, find a hotel and book it once you say go. Then the catch: the app is free, and you pay your AI provider for each task, so set the monthly cap first.
pitch.lands: Everyone hates the cancel maze, and this hands it to a robot with endless patience.
pitch.why_now: n8n Labs released Nod on 10 November 2026.
pitch.share: Let the robot sit through the offers to stay.

thu_options_not_offered.dive: Nod works in your own apps and browser, each task shows its cost, and the only bill is the AI model you connect, which you can cap each month.
thu_options_not_offered.funny: A robot with endless patience finally wins against the are-you-sure-you-want-to-leave screen.

lookalike.our_take: One free tool shown doing three real chores, with the cost catch said plainly, where the post sells a course.

source.label: IT Brief UK, 11 Nov 2026, on OpenAI's Businesses in ChatGPT (opened 10 Nov)

thu_options_not_offered.copy: OpenAI opened Business Hub on 10 November: a business can claim its listing in ChatGPT, verify it, fix its details and see how often it is mentioned. Six cards on how to claim yours and what it will not change.
thu_options_not_offered.hook: ChatGPT already talks about your business. Now you can correct it.

pitch.see: Six cards. Cover: a cafe owner glaring at a giant chat bubble that has their opening hours wrong. Then: what Business Hub is; claim and verify your listing from the ChatGPT sidebar; add your own products and prices; what you see (mentions, website clicks and the topics people ask about, never anyone's chats); the catch (ChatGPT still decides what to recommend). Last card: claim yours this week.
pitch.lands: Every owner has a wrong-listing story, and this one has a quick fix.
pitch.why_now: OpenAI opened Business Hub on 10 November 2026.
pitch.share: Check what ChatGPT says about your business.

thu_options_not_offered.dive: Claiming a listing lets a business correct the facts ChatGPT reads about it and see counts of mentions and clicks, while ChatGPT still chooses what to recommend.
thu_options_not_offered.funny: ChatGPT has been telling people your cafe opens at 6am on Sundays, and now you can make it stop.

lookalike.our_take: Made for the owner, where the post is for the user: how to fix what ChatGPT says about you, and the one thing it will not fix.

source.label: United Airlines newsroom, 11 Nov 2026, United Restricts Access for Third-Party AI Agents

thu_options_not_offered.copy: On 11 November United said it will block personal AI agents from booking and managing its flights, because handing them your login can expose your details and lead to purchases you never meant. A two-panel meme about the first airline to turn the robots away at the desk.
thu_options_not_offered.hook: My AI agent tried to book my flight. United said no.

pitch.see: Panel one: the house robot at an airline check-in desk, proudly holding up its owner's passport. Panel two: the desk agent pointing at a sign, NO ROBOTS PAST THIS POINT, while the owner sighs behind the robot. Small print: United, 11 Nov 2026.
pitch.lands: Everyone has pictured their AI doing the boring booking, and the first big airline just said not here.
pitch.why_now: United announced the restriction on 11 November 2026.
pitch.share: Plan it with AI. Book it yourself.

thu_options_not_offered.dive: An agent that books for you needs your password, and United says that can expose your details, cause purchases or miles spent that you never meant, and break the rule that a human checks in.
thu_options_not_offered.funny: The first airline to stop a passenger's robot at the desk.

lookalike.our_take: This time a company says no to the AI, and the reason is your password.

sat_goodnews_stories_found.what: Thatsign, built by a team in Lagos and London, turns speech or typing into British Sign Language and turns signing back into words; it is a prototype due around mid-2027.
sat_goodnews_stories_found.why: More than nine in 10 deaf children are born to hearing parents, so families need a way to talk.
